questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Select the correct statement
options: Antagonists are the substances which inhibit the natural function of receptor site
Agonists are the drugs that mimic the natural messenger by switching on the receptor
Substrates may bind to active site of enzyme through the variety of interactions such as ionic bonding, H-bonding, Van dar Waal's  interaction or dipole-dipole interaction
questions.solution:
There are a large number of different receptors in the body that interact with different chemical messengers. These receptors show selectivity for one chemical messenger over the other because their binding sites have different shape, structure and amino acid composition.

Drugs that bind to the receptor site and inhibit its natural function are called antagonists. These are useful when blocking of message is required. There are other types of drugs that mimic the natural messenger by switching on the receptor, these are called agonists.

These are useful when there is lack of natural chemical messenger.

Same substances can act as an antiseptic as well as disinfectant by varying the concentration. For example, 0.2 percent solution of phenol is an antiseptic while its one percent solution is disinfectant.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Biodegradable detergents contains:
questions.solution:
Main problem that appears in the use of detergents is that if their hydrocarbon chain is highly branched, then bacteria cannot degrade this easily. Slow degradation of detergents leads to their accumulation.

These days the branching of the hydrocarbon chain is controlled and kept to the minimum. Unbranched chains, i.e., n-alkyl chains can be biodegraded more easily and hence pollution is prevented.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
Evaluate the correct matching order of the following terms.
 
i Narcotic drugs a Artificial sweetner
ii. Saponification b Heroin
iii Alitame c Hydrolysis of fats and oils
questions.solution:
(i) Narcotic drugs: Certain narcotics are also used as analgesics. For example, morphine and its derivatives codeine, heroin, marijuana are used in server pain as analgesics. These are known to be habit-forming.

(ii) Saponification: When oil and fats are heated with a solution of sodium hydroxide, they break down to sodium salt of the respective fatty acid and glycerol. This process of making soap by the hydrolysis of fats and oils with alkalies is called saponification.

(iii) Alitame: It is more stable than aspartame during cooking. It is high potency sweetener and one main difficulty with alitame and similar type of high potency sweetener is the difficulty in controlling the sweeteners of the food.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which of the following doesn't represent a surfactant?
questions.solution:
Every surfactant contains two parts a hydrophobic part and a hydrophilic part.

Hydrophobic part belongs to the long non polar carbon chain with some side chains. It is called as hydrophobic because it does not interact witht the water or water repellant.

Hydrophilic part belongs to the ionic head of the surfactant. It attracts the water molecules towards itself and combine with the water. It is water loving part.

Every surfactant must consists both of these hydrophobic and hydrophilic part for better cleansing ability of that surfacntant.

The compound

CH3CH214CH2NH2 contains only hydrophobic part but no hydrophilic part, hence it is not a surfactant.
